parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression, and no documented traveller-facing rule (border, facility, custody or emergency-care exclusion) in the dossier. Supreme Court rulings protect trans recognition, and civil society is active. Against this, the dossier documents physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people and discrimination in government institutions in provincial cities (Nov 2024), with thin recourse. Political hostility is rising (2024 rally, April 2026 death threats from supporters), though these are non-state acts. Gender-affirming care is scarce, and a 2011 census incident is dated. No trans-specific violence rate is usable. Documents reach visitors on home passports, so resident-facing gaps weigh little. Net: reduced-to-elevated risk, driven by societal harassment with weak recourse rather than state exposure.
